text: Hello, boys and girls, welcome to Daisy's class.Today, we will go on reviewing reading.And this time, we'll talk about argumentative articles.This is what you are going to learn during the lesson.Please get your pen and the worksheet ready.Let's get started.Can you think of any argumentative articles you have ever learned?Great!Actually, for New Century English, there are three articles.For or against keeping pets.Should students be allowed to choose their own clothes?To own or not to own a car.For Oxford English, there is only one.Is keeping a pet dog a good idea?The argumentative articles we learned have a lot in common.They all have a topic for discussion.All the topics are related to our daily life and arguable.Different opinions expressed, being in favor of or against.Logical arguments presented by using transition words or phrases.Evidence for supporting the opinions, usually facts and examples.No final agreement reached.Besides a topic for discussion, there are other types of argumentative articles.They are one-sided argument, agree or disagree to something.Two-sided argument, present both views and give one's own opinion.Advantages and disadvantages of something.Problem and solution.The basic structure of an argumentative article is topic and arguments and then conclusion.While reading different views on a given topic for discussion, we should follow the steps below.Figure out the topic, what is being discussed.Scan for different opinions, pros and cons, but means for and against.Scan for evidence, supporting details.Let's get some practice.Read the material below and answer the questions on your worksheet.Please take a look at task one on your worksheet.You've got two minutes to do this.学员B我认为这不是中国的好主意学员C我认为中国人不需要给学员们建议学员D这不是中国人的选择第三个问题中国学员A有多少理由要给学员们建议太好了第二个问题学员们不仅给学员们建议表达感谢还要鼓励学员们努力工作我们可以在文章中简单地分析学员们的意见在文章中简单地分析学员们的意见例如我认为我认为我认为我认为但有时候学员们在不同的方式表达意见我们来看看学员D的例子再读一下在西方国家通常给学员们建议建议只是一个传统他们有自己的文化我们有自己的我们有自己的生活方式不适合跟随外国人一样他先给学员D一些背景资料然后他表达了他的意见明白吗?让我们继续练习让我们继续练习接下来是第一篇文章中的第一篇文章读着读着文章中的意见读着读着文章中的意见读着读着文章中的意见读着读着文章中的意见Time's up!Have you got the answers?Paragraph 8The last sentenceThe writer thinks a smile can also hide true feelings and often causes confusion across cultures.Here, confusion is the noun form of great.It's the noun form of confused.Paragraph BWhat's the writer's opinion?Perfect!The last sentenceHowever, it would be a serious mistake to replace libraries with tablets.Obviously, the writer is against replacing libraries with tablets.Pay attention to the word tablets.Can you guess the meaning from the context?Wonderful!Tablets are electronic devices like iPads.So much for task 2.Let's move on.To make the article more convincing, the writer always presents arguments in a logical way with evidence.Let's take the one we read just now as an example.You've got 30 seconds to read through it quickly.The writer is against replacing libraries with tablets.He used transition words first, additionally, and furthermore to present his arguments logically.Let's take a look at another example.You've got one minute to read it quickly.However, it would be a serious mistake to replace libraries with tablets.However, the writer is against replacing libraries with tablets.You've got one minute to read through it quickly.Okay, while reading the first paragraph, I think you can get the topic.That is, too much praise can lead to the opposite effect.In the third and the fourth paragraphs, the writer presented a test by psychologist Dr.Deck and quoted his words to support the opinion.The act of repeating something useful that another person has said or written is called quotation.Alright, let's move on to the last example.You always get some time to read it, but this time only 30 seconds.Let's read it together.On the other hand, it can help us understand the writer presented both views on is stress a good thing or a bad thing.In the second paragraph, the writer used an example and fact to prove some people's opinion stress is a bad thing.In the third paragraph, the writer used his personal experience to support the opinion stress is not a bad thing.So, to make the article more convincing, the writer might include plenty of evidences in it.The evidences could be facts, research, study, survey, data, and so on.Examples, story, personal experience, and so on.Theories, quotations from scientists, experts, and so on.To make the article more persuasive, the writer often restates the opinion at the end of the article.Let's read part of an article to see how it works.30 seconds to read, okay?The writer thinks body language is important.We can get it from these two sentences.At the end of the article, from the sentence, so, it's very important for us to learn body language.We can see the writer restates his opinion.So far, we've read several examples and got to know how the writer made the article more convincing and persuasive.Now, let's have some practice.Please move on to task three.Read the passage below and choose the best answer.You've got three minutes to do it.【翻譯】時間到了,讓我們來看看1.What does the writer think of being fat?Which one do you choose?The writer thinks being fat is the result of people's unbalanced lifestyle.We can find the evidence from these two sentences.The main reason is that they share the same habits of eating too much and exercising too little.They also fail to realize how much they eat.According to the writer, how can we make exercise more exciting?Excellent!By taking varied exercise.The underlined sentence can help you get the answer.The key is to develop a balanced and varied program that's fun as well as progressive.What's the writer's opinion about no pain, no gain in exercising?Exactly!B is the best answer.We can learn from the underlined sentence.Indeed, pain is your body telling you something's wrong and continuing to exercise could lead to serious injury.What is the purpose of the passage?At the very beginning of the article, the writer mentioned there have always been a lot of commonly believed but false ideas about being fat and doing exercise.Have you got all the right answers?Good job!That's all we need to learn today.In today's lesson, we mainly reviewed the argumentative articles we learned, the basic structure of an argumentative article, how to read different views on a given topic for discussion, how to figure out the writer's opinion, how the writer made the article more convincing and persuasive.Here's your homework.Finish the reading task on your homework sheet.Have a nice day!See you!
